apps.name: Flight Executive
apps.description: Flight scheduler and executive for managing app execution.

fields.description: Current system time onboard the spacecraft, zero at power-on.

telemetry.name: APP_ERROR
telemetry.description: App error tracking packet, produced when an app returns error or warning.

fields.description: The APID of the app returning error.
The error code returned by the app.

telemetry.name: SCHEDULE_OVERRUN
telemetry.description: Schedule overrun tracking packet, produced when an app overruns its schedule slot.

fields.description: The APID of the app which overran.
The schedule slot the app was scheduled for.
The schedule slot where the app actually returned.
Rolling count of successfully sent packets.
Count of dropped packets due to queueing errors.
Count of dropped packets due to CCSDS failures.
Count of dropped packets due to interface error.
Count of dropped packets due to overwritten packets.

fields.description: The updated telemetry rate (seconds component).
The updated telemetry rate (nanoseconds component).

commands.name: CLEAR_QUEUE
commands.description: Clear the telemetry queues.

fields.description: Set true to clear the telemetry queue.

commands.name: MAX_BYTES_PER_STEP
commands.description: Set the maximum bytes per step for telemetry sending. Setting to 0 pauses all telemetry.

fields.description: The maximum number of bytes to allow per telemetry step.

apps.name: Command Manager

fields.description: Rolling count of command execution errors.

fields.description: The APID of the app to change.

The instance of the app to schedule.

apps.name: Onboard Communications Manager
apps.description: Manages CSP-based onboard inter-node communications, routing inbound and outbound packets between registered apps and the CSP bus.

telemetry.name: STATUS
telemetry.description: Onboard communications (CSP) manager status packet reporting rolling bus health counters.

fields.description: Rolling count of payloads delivered to apps.
Rolling count of payloads transmitted to the bus.
Count of received packets with no registered port.
Count of failed transmissions.
Count of sends that could not be routed.
Count of CSP buffer acquisition failures.

commands.name: CLEAR_COUNTERS
commands.description: Reset the rolling rx/tx/error counters reported in the status telemetry.

fields.description: Set true to clear all status counters.

commands.name: MAX_PKTS_PER_STEP
commands.description: Set the maximum number of CSP packets routed per scheduler step.

fields.description: Max CSP packets to route per execute() call.

apps.name: Inertial Navigation Magnetometer Measurement Update
apps.description: Inertial Navigation EKF magnetometer measurement update step.

telemetry.name: STATE
telemetry.description: State after a successful magnetometer measurement update step.

fields.description: 10 element state vector [pos vel quat ang_vel_bias accel_bias].
10 diagonal covariance matrix elements corresponding to states in state_vector.
Status of measurement processing (0=success, 1=invalid input, 2=time rejected, 3=residual rejected).

commands.name: SET_NOISE
commands.description: Change the magnetometer measurement noise standard deviation.

fields.description: Magnetic field vector measurement standard deviation resolved in magnetometer frame.

telemetry.name: PROP_STATE
telemetry.description: State after a successful EKF propagation step.

fields.description: 10 element state vector [pos vel quat ang_vel_bias accel_bias].
10 diagonal covariance matrix elements corresponding to states in state_vector.

commands.name: SET_NOISE
commands.description: Change the EKF propagation step process noise standard deviations.

fields.description: Noise due to dynamics applied to velocity.
Noise due to accelerometer applied to velocity.
Noise due to gyro inflated and applied to attitude.

telemetry.name: DATA

fields.description: Quaternion describing the output pointing calculation.

apps.name: Simulation Interface
apps.description: Downlinks simulated spacecraft and ADCS state and accepts ground commands that retarget and re-mode the ADCS. One instance per spacecraft, differentiated by APID instance.

telemetry.name: SC_DATA
telemetry.description: All the telemetry related to the spacecraft

fields.description: Spacecraft position wrt the planet centered inertial frame. Double because a float32 quantizes a lunar-orbit planet-centered position (~2e7 m) to a couple of meters.
Spacecraft velocity wrt the planet centered inertial frame.
Spacecraft attitude quaternion wrt the planet inertial frame, scalar first.
Spacecraft angular velocity wrt the planet inertial frame, expressed in the body frame.
Geodetic altitude of the spacecraft wrt the planet ellipsoid.
Total power generated by all power sources registered to the spacecraft.
Total power drawn by all power loads registered to the spacecraft.

telemetry.name: ADCS_DATA
telemetry.description: All of the data from the ADCS

fields.description: Wheel speed of each reaction wheel, indexed in ADCS wheel order. Wheels beyond the configured count read zero.
Momentum stored by each reaction wheel, indexed in ADCS wheel order.
Saturation flag for each reaction wheel, indexed in ADCS wheel order.
Active ADCS mode: 0 = detumble, 1 = nominal operations, 2 = fine pointing. Read back from the mode output, so an ADCS auto-demotion out of fine pointing shows up here.
Body the ADCS primary constraint is currently aimed at: 0 = Earth, 1 = Moon, 2 = Sun.
Total power drawn by the ADCS reaction wheels and torque rods.
Total system angular momentum in the body frame: spacecraft body momentum plus momentum stored in every reaction wheel.

commands.name: CHANGE_POINTING_TARGET
commands.description: The command to change the primary pointing target of the ADCS

fields.description: Body to aim the ADCS primary body constraint at: 0 = Earth, 1 = Moon, 2 = Sun. Rejected if the selected body's frame input was never wired.

commands.name: ADCS_MODE
commands.description: Command to change the mode of the ADCS

fields.description: ADCS mode to command: 0 = detumble, 1 = nominal operations, 2 = fine pointing. Any other value is rejected.

commands.name: RESET
commands.description: Resetting an ADCS
